input.query: SELECT a.month, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END) AS active_users, SUM(a.card_spend_eur) AS card_spend_eur, SUM(a.card_spend_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END),0) AS spend_per_active_user, SUM(a.n_card_txns) AS card_txns, SUM(a.n_card_txns)*1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END),0) AS txns_per_active_user FROM fct_activity_monthly a JOIN dim_users u USING (user_id) WHERE u.country = 'Romania' AND a.month >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND a.month < DATE '2026-06-01' GROUP BY a.month ORDER BY a.month
